Slop Watermark · free, in your browser

Tile a watermark across the whole picture

A watermark in one corner is easy to crop away. A pattern repeated across the picture, at an angle and half transparent, protects proofs, previews and stock photos while they can still be seen.

Make a tiled watermark

How to do it

  1. Drop the pictures on the page.
  2. Type your text (or choose Your logo and upload it).
  3. Tick Repeat across the picture (tiles), then set the Rotation, for example -30°.
  4. Lower the Opacity until the picture shows through, and check the preview.
  5. Press Apply to all and download the results.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Watermark runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Can a tiled watermark be removed?

Any watermark can be edited out with enough effort, but a pattern over the whole picture is much harder to remove than one in a corner.

Can I rotate the watermark?

Yes. Rotation goes from -90° to 90°, for tiled and single watermarks alike.

Which picture types work?

PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF and SVG. A GIF is saved as a still PNG with the watermark.
